components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The solid blue action for the primary operation in a region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--accent-600); color: #fff; font: 500 14px/1 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); transition: background-color var(--transition-base), transform var(--transition-base); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-500); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-500); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.96); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A neutral bordered action for supporting operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text-secondary); font: 500 14px/1 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; transition: background-color var(--transition-base), color var(--transition-base), transform var(--transition-base); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-500); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(.96); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A compact chrome field with the shared text-entry glow.
components.html: <label class="ds-input"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"></circle><path d="m20 20-3.5-3.5"></path></svg><input type="search" placeholder="Search tasks…"></label>
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--surface-0); color: var(--text-muted); transition: border-color var(--transition-base), box-shadow var(--transition-base); } .ds-input:focus-within { border-color: var(--border-focus); box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus-glow); } .ds-input svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-input input { width: 100%; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The desktop rail locator with a raised surface and narrow blue marker.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-active { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 40px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text-primary); font: 500 13px/1 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: var(--surface-3); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-nav-active svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: none; stroke: var(--accent-soft); stroke-width: 1.8; } .ds-nav-marker { position: absolute; left: 0; width: 3px; height: 16px; border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0; background: var(--accent); }

components.name: Semantic Badge
components.description: A labeled status pill using a muted solid field and complete border.
components.css: .ds-badge-success { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 20%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-full); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success-muted) 30%, transparent); color: var(--success); font: 500 12px/1.4 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; transition: border-color var(--transition-fast); } .ds-badge-success:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 40%, transparent); } .ds-badge-success:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--success); }

components.name: Operational Card
components.description: The default solid panel with a quiet complete border.
components.html:
Plan & Focus

Choose the next task from current priorities.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--text-primary); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); transition: border-color var(--transition-base); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font: 600 16px/1.2 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-tertiary); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; }

components.name: Semantic Assessment Panel
components.description: A solid tinted insight container with a complete semantic border.
components.html:
Pattern detected

Tuesday completion is consistently strongest.
components.css: .ds-assessment { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--info) 30%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--info-muted) 20%, transparent); color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-assessment:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--info) 45%, transparent); } .ds-assessment:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-assessment-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-top: 4px; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--info); } .ds-assessment strong { color: var(--info); font: 600 12px/1.4 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-assessment p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; }

components.name: Compact KPI Bar
components.description: The shared collapsible desktop summary with divided inline metrics instead of standalone cards.
components.css: .ds-kpi-bar { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-kpi-header { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 40px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); font: 600 12px/1 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-kpi-header:hover { background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-kpi-header:focus-visible, .ds-kpi-metric:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-kpi-header svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; transform: rotate(90deg); } .ds-kpi-row { display: flex; min-width: 560px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-kpi-metric { display: flex; min-height: 56px; min-width: 0; flex: 1; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--border); background: transparent; color: inherit; text-align: left; } .ds-kpi-metric:hover { background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-kpi-icon { display: inline-flex; width: 28px; height: 28px; flex: 0 0 auto; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success-muted) 30%, transparent); color: var(--success); font: 600 14px/1 sans-serif; } .ds-kpi-icon-warning { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning-muted) 30%, transparent); color: var(--warning); } .ds-kpi-icon svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-kpi-metric small { display: block; color: var(--text-muted); font: 400 12px/1.2 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-kpi-metric strong { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--text-primary); font: 600 16px/1 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Mobile Attention Queue
components.description: The first mobile dashboard region, prioritizing urgent queues before status and secondary destinations.
components.html: Needs AttentionFix OverdueReschedule or complete3 overdue
components.css: .ds-attention { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-attention-label { color: var(--text-muted); font: 600 12px/1 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-attention-action { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin: 12px -4px 0; padding: 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color var(--transition-base); } .ds-attention-action:hover { background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-attention-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-attention-icon { display: inline-flex; width: 36px; height: 36px; flex: 0 0 auto; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger-muted) 30%, transparent); color: var(--danger); } .ds-attention-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-attention-copy { min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-attention-copy strong, .ds-attention-copy small { display: block; } .ds-attention-copy strong { font: 500 14px/1.3 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-attention-copy small { margin-top: 2px; color: var(--text-muted); font: 400 12px/1.3 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-attention-badge { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-full); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger-muted) 30%, transparent); color: #fca5a5; font: 600 12px/1.4 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

components.css: .ds-empty { padding: 24px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--text-secondary); text-align: center; } .ds-empty svg { display: block; width: 24px; height: 24px; margin: 0 auto 8px; fill: none; stroke: var(--success); stroke-width: 2; } .ds-empty strong { display: block; font: 500 14px/1.4 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-empty p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--text-muted); font: 400 12px/1.4 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-empty:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Mission Control is a dark-first hybrid workspace: a dense desktop operational command center and a guided mobile action surface. Its visual hierarchy comes from disciplined slate surfaces, quiet borders, compact type, and small semantic signals rather than decorative effects. Desktop preserves broad scanability; mobile deliberately sequences the most urgent work before summary and secondary navigation.

Blue identifies action, selection, focus, and progress. Other hues carry explicit status, priority, source, or project meaning. Compact summaries, empty states, and notices reduce vertical occupation without removing labels or actions. Assessment surfaces favor solid semantic fills and restrained tonal backgrounds; purple-to-indigo decoration is not part of the operational container language.
keyCharacteristics: Dense desktop command center paired with a guided, action-first mobile sequence
Solid tonal surfaces separated by quiet full borders
Semantic color expressed through text, badges, progress fills, border tints, and dots
Compact shared summaries, notices, and empty states that return space to live work
Fast state transitions with stronger motion reserved for direct manipulation
Responsive shell that swaps the desktop rail for mobile header and bottom navigation

rules.name: The Solid Signal Rule
rules.body: Operational cards, recommendations, schedule blocks, insights, and progress bars use a solid neutral or semantic fill. Do not use purple/indigo gradients to manufacture importance.

rules.name: The Semantic Evidence Rule
rules.body: Color must correspond to an action, state, priority, project, or source and must be reinforced by text, iconography, or position.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Build hierarchy with Geist size, weight, color, and spacing; do not introduce a display face.

rules.name: The Dense Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Whitespace separates groups and establishes scan order; it is not decorative. Prefer the established 4px rhythm and avoid oversized empty bands.

rules.name: The Context-Adaptive Density Rule
rules.body: Preserve simultaneous scan breadth on desktop; on mobile, spend the first viewport on immediate action and defer status and navigation behind it.

rules.name: The Surface-First Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with tonal surfaces and quiet borders before adding shadow.

rules.name: The Focus-Is-Input Rule
rules.body: The accent glow communicates text entry. Buttons use visible focus rings; selected rows use contained rings or surface changes.

rules.name: The Complete Container Rule
rules.body: Status and assessment containers use a full neutral or semantic border. Reserve unilateral bars for native navigation location or quoted content.

dos: Do use solid surface steps and quiet complete borders for operational hierarchy.
Do use dots, text, icons, and solid progress fills for project, phase, source, priority, and health signals.
Do keep common state transitions at 100–150ms and reserve 300–500ms movement for shell expansion, progress interpolation, and direct manipulation.
Do use skeletons for content loading and visible focus treatment for keyboard interaction.
Do preserve compact spacing and at least 40px touch targets in mobile navigation and high-frequency actions.
Do collapse or shrink empty operational regions so the remaining live work keeps viewport priority.
Do put urgent mobile actions before status summaries and secondary destinations.
donts: Don't use purple/indigo or multicolor gradients as generic emphasis on cards, assessment panels, schedule blocks, or data bars.
Don't use thick left borders or inset side stripes on ordinary content containers; use a full border or a small semantic dot.
Don't use the blue accent decoratively or let connector hues take over a panel.
Don't add shadows where a surface step and border already establish hierarchy.
Don't add a second icon library or a decorative display typeface.
Don't exceed 300ms for ordinary state feedback.
Don't turn desktop KPI summaries into oversized standalone metric cards.
Don't let a mobile status summary or destination menu outrank Needs Attention.
